master_title: "Web renderer fixture — one slide per layout"
slides:
  - slide: 1
    title: "A dark opening claim"
    point: "Title slides establish the master claim"
    insight: "The first slide buys you the next ten seconds"
    body: "Open dark, say the claim once."
    visual: "full-bleed dark hero"
    visual_source: "generate"
    evidence: "fixture"
    layout: "title-dark"
    arc: "what-is"
    notes_draft: "Fixture slide 1."
    diagram:
      sub: "the fixture sub-line"
  - slide: 2
    title: "Two columns side by side"
    point: "Comparison layouts carry paired evidence"
    insight: "A comparison only works if both sides are comparable"
    body: "Polished is not the same as argued."
    visual: "two columns"
    visual_source: "generate"
    evidence: "fixture"
    layout: "comparison-columns"
    arc: "what-is"
    notes_draft: "Fixture slide 2."
    diagram:
      columns:
        - heading: "Polished"
          lines:
            - "layout and colour"
            - "solved"
        - heading: "Arguing"
          lines:
            - "claim and evidence"
            - "not solved"
  - slide: 3
    title: "Steps in a sequence"
    point: "Flow layouts show ordered progression"
    insight: "A process without an order is just a list"
    body: "Three steps, in order."
    visual: "horizontal step row"
    visual_source: "generate"
    evidence: "fixture"
    layout: "flow-diagram"
    arc: "what-could-be"
    notes_draft: "Fixture slide 3."
    diagram:
      steps:
        - label: "pitch"
          sub: "extract"
        - label: "grind"
          sub: "structure"
        - label: "build"
          sub: "transcribe"
  - slide: 4
    title: "Rows of supporting points"
    point: "Icon rows stack parallel evidence"
    insight: "Three rows is the ceiling before it becomes a wall"
    body: "Parallel points, evenly weighted."
    visual: "stacked rows with icons"
    visual_source: "generate"
    evidence: "fixture"
    layout: "icon-rows"
    arc: "what-could-be"
    notes_draft: "Fixture slide 4."
    diagram:
      rows:
        - icon: "◆"
          label: "first row"
          note: "supporting detail one"
        - icon: "◆"
          label: "second row"
          note: "supporting detail two"
        - icon: "◆"
          label: "third row"
          note: "supporting detail three"
  - slide: 5
    title: "One chart carries the point"
    point: "Chart focus puts data ahead of prose"
    insight: "A chart without a claim is decoration"
    body: "Show the shape, then say what it means."
    visual: "chart with checklist"
    visual_source: "generate"
    evidence: "fixture"
    layout: "chart-focus"
    arc: "call-to-action"
    notes_draft: "Fixture slide 5."
    diagram:
      checklist:
        - "one series, one message"
        - "axis labels visible"
        - "callout states the so-what"
  - slide: 6
    title: "A single number to remember"
    point: "Stat callouts isolate the most repeatable fact"
    insight: "If the number is not defensible, do not put it on a slide"
    body: "One number, honestly framed."
    visual: "giant fluid number"
    visual_source: "generate"
    evidence: "fixture"
    layout: "stat-callout"
    arc: "new-bliss"
    notes_draft: "Fixture slide 6."
    diagram:
      stat: "36/14"
      statLabel: "pt minimum title and body on every slide"
      tail: "convention, not lab science"
